units.id: tip:active cooling:|Cooling provided per second when running at full strength. units.english: Determines how long it takes to perform a cargo scan. A higher value will correspond to a quicker scan.

units.id: tip:cloak:|This outfit allows your ship to cloak. The value represents how long it takes to fully activate or deactivate cloaking. Ships cannot fire while cloaked, except if they have the related "cloaked firing" attribute.|130|0
units.english: This outfit allows your ship to cloak. The value represents how long it takes to fully activate or deactivate cloaking. Ships cannot fire while cloaked, except if they have the related "cloaked firing" attribute.

units.id: tip:cloak by mass:|This outfit allows your ship to cloak. The value represents how long it takes to fully activate or deactivate cloaking for a ship with 1000 mass. The higher a ship's mass, the slower the cloak works, the lower its mass, the faster the cloak works. Ships cannot fire while cloaked, except if they have the related "cloaked firing" attribute.|133|0
units.english: This outfit allows your ship to cloak. The value represents how long it takes to fully activate or deactivate cloaking for a ship with 1000 mass. The higher a ship's mass, the slower the cloak works, the lower its mass, the faster the cloak works. Ships cannot fire while cloaked, except if they have the related "cloaked firing" attribute.

units.id: tip:cloaking energy:|Energy consumed per second when cloaked.|136|0
units.english: Energy consumed per second when cloaked.
